title: Phase-resolved field-space distance criteria in ekpyrotic, bouncing and cyclic cosmologies
summary: The inflationary Lyth bound relates the primordial tensor amplitude to the inflaton field excursion. In ekpyrotic, bouncing and cyclic cosmologies there is no analogous universal tensor-to-field-distance relation because scalar and tensor perturbations depend on entropy conversion, matching through the bounce, and the specific mechanism that violates or evades the null energy condition. Here we propose a phase-resolved criterion for the accumulated scalar field trajectory length in a non-inflationary smoothing history.
